title: Plain-input SAT with a smaller polynomially budgeted 2-CNF backdoor
claims: PrefixClauseSATInP constructs a language in the exact reference P contained in the original SAT language. It decides satisfiability when the distinct names in the first max(clause length − 2, 0) literal positions of each clause have polynomially many assignments.
PrefixBackdoorBudgetImproves proves that this automatically extracted parameter is never larger than the prior all-long-clause parameter and is strictly smaller on a concrete CNF.
P_subset_NP is separately checked against the exact reference definitions.
